reviews.review:
This is definitely the best Left 4 Dead-like game to come out. Ignore the negative reviews, a lot of them are for way old versions of the game and it has come a long way since its initial Early Access launch. Devs are good people and highly communicative with their players.

Now if only Will Smith would stop slapping people...

Lots of fun and very satisfying to play, visually striking and pretty snappy gunplay. Leaves me wanting for a melee system though. The dead, blank, stony expressions of the characters are a bit off putting amidst all the style and visual flare. Otherwise, it's a fun and good looking evening or two worth of multiplayer scifi action.

When hearing that anybody that worked on Left 4 Dead and or Left 4 Dead 2 worked on this you expect big things as left for dead 2 had such great life to the characters such great feeling to the AI that you were fighting against. It felt alive it felt like it had character to the game each episode felt like you were traversing through something that was alive in some way. This although it's shiny and new and looks nice because it's on a much newer engine and made now instead of when Left 4 Dead 2 was made feels lifeless hollow the AI for the enemies are nothing to get excited about nothing that you could call any improvement over Left 4 Dead 2 the AI that fights alongside you with each character nothing to get excited about in fact they're actually worse than the AI for Left 4 Dead 2 to the point where you're dead on the ground and they don't do anything to help you. Why? that is so frustrating and the aliens are just aliens or creatures or whatever you want to call them but there's nothing special looking about any of them there's nothing to get excited about it's not unique or cool looking or anything that brings life to the enemies they're just boring generic alien one boring generic alien 2 boring generic whatever bigger alien monster and there's nothing special about the way they look that makes them interesting or fun or compelling they're just plain and boring just like the environments your traversing through nothing special exciting or interesting about them. You're not going to be looking around for any cool hidden easter eggs you're not going to be looking around for anything like oh cool I remember that billboard nothing it's just boring plane and generic nothing to get excited about nothing to be like oh I want to go through that again I remember that one area that's a fun area nothing like that here and the minute you start getting overwhelmed all of your guns are inadequate and none of them really come across as well I like that gun they're all just boring generic sci-fi gun 1 boring generic sci-fi gun 2 they sound cool but none of them are even remotely interesting and there is nowhere near enough variety and what makes it even worse... The update they just put out they're claiming that this is the update right before they hit 1.0 next week as I'm writing this if this is what they're passing off as ready for 1.0 do not buy! do not buy! do not pass go cuz now they're going to be relying heavily on the community to make this game even remotely fun and/or interesting and one of the things that was a little annoying in Left 4 Dead 2 was when big enemies came at you Hunter or whatever it was and the other characters would call that out it was a tiny bit annoying as they repeated that over and over again but understandable communicative and justifiable but... in this game holy cow is that the most irritating I just want them to shut up as they repeat it over and over and over again and then do nothing to kill the creature that alone made me want to refund it and the amount of times they're just down and need help getting back up versus Left 4 Dead 2 where that was so much less frequent and these guns I can't stress how generic boring sci-fi gun they are no thought or life put into any of these guns to make them feel anything other than boring generic sci-fi gun 1 boring generic sci-fi gun 2 same thing with the environments boring generic sci-fi environment 1 boring generic sci-fi environment 2 and the characters... I don't know any of their names I don't feel like I should care to know any of their names there's no real like hey this is the characters backstory this is why this character is cool this is why you enjoy playing this character none of that but so many of us can recall the characters from Left 4 Dead 1 and 2 and how cool and interesting each character was. None of that here and considering there are devs that have worked on left for dead 1 and 2 on this team yet there's no life no character to this game it is just boring generic sci-fi team-based go through episodes shooter with boring generic just a couple of weapons and nothing to get excited about with boring generic not very great AI helping you with not very good AI fighting against you as the alien creatures that again are not created with anything other than boring generic sci-fi in mind. These are not stand out creatures like in left for dead and left for dead 2 where you're looking at that and you're going that's the hunter or oh that's the witch you know it's just boring generic here and that's the best way to put this game in a nutshell if they say this is 1.0 then we can slap the boring generic sci-fi label on this but that's sad cuz I had high hopes for this... Does it run well yes it does. Does it look nice compared to other games out there yeah it's running on a modern game engine so all the textures are nice and crispy clean but that does not make for a compelling reason to purchase this there's no episode that makes me go I want to replay that right now there's no part of an episode that makes me go yeah let's do that again none of that like there was in Left for Dead 2 none of that here there's no weapons that you go oh I always want to use that one cuz that's fun none of that here just boring generic sci-fi. I'm not quite sure but seems like it kind of has a 70s theme don't quote me on that but that's the vibe that I'm getting but that doesn't make it more compelling not at all just lots of whites and browns or at least that was the episodes that I played but still boring generic corridor 1 boring generic corridor 2 boring generic corridor 3 get behind the thing close the door move on to episode 2 boring generic corridor 4 boring generic corridor 5 get behind the next door close it next episode and so on and so forth with nothing memorable about any portion of that...

This is the closest to a Left 4 Dead successor that there currently is. The 60’s retro future is well executed. Right now the big hurdle to this game is the player base, it's currently small. At the upcoming launch in December 2023 I hope this isn’t an issue anymore.
Pretty good so far, but I would love to see blood added in for more effect when killing aliens.
Reviewing for the steam awards stuff ngl but the game itself is quite good.
Lacks sound effects, atmosphere is just lame. Play L4D2 instead.

[b]Needs work, but The Anacrusis brings lots of fresh ideas and fun gameplay to the genre. This is an excellent foundation to build upon and polish.[/b]

+Very cool retroscifi aesthetic
+The perk draft system guarantees a different approach to every run
+Banger music
+Fun and original grenade effects
+[i]Vibe check your retinas by removing the brightness limiter from the flash monster[/i]

-Some weapons feel flimsy and weightless
-Animations for the monsters often look janky
-Some parts of the maps are confusing, leading to dead time and therefore boring gameplay

The Anacrusis is a retro-futuristic space shooter where you and up to three friends fight off waves of aliens. Playing co-op really forces teamwork and planning. There's an AI Driver that adjusts difficulty as you play. This stops things from getting too easy or impossibly hard. I think this feature actually works pretty well.

The game isn't finished yet though, and it shows. The shooting feels off compared to other games like this. The impact doesn't feel right when you hit enemies. There aren't many different enemy types either, and I wish the characters would chat with each other more. The maps need more detail too.

Even with these problems, The Anacrusis has this cool 70s sci-fi vibe that I actually like. The co-op is fun with friends. The game has potential, and I'm interested to see where they take it.

I know I am probably in the minority here. I like to play with a controller and a mouse. I find the movement and aiming to be more precise. Most modern games support that arrangement. Anacrusis does not. I have asked the developers a few times to make whatever change they need to make to allow me to play that way. Each patch I anxiously update and try, but still no fix for me. Am I really asking that much? To the developers, please make the change so I can play the game the way I want. I can't be the only one that plays like that am I?
reviews.developer_response: That change has been in for the last few months! You just need to Enable Mixed Input in the Gameplay settings screen and you can use whatever combination of inputs you'd like.
